summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K on 6/9/2026 to disclose that its subsidiary, APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC, priced a $1.59 billion offering of 7.000% senior secured notes due 2031 at par. The notes are sold to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-US persons under Regulation S. Net proceeds will fund 150 MW of AI factory construction, repay a bridge loan from Goldman Sachs, fund reserves, and pay expenses. Closing is expected around 6/16/2026. This is a debt financing, not a special situation; no M&A, activist campaign, or structural change is involved.
